notes.title: Fixes 05-09-22
notes.content:
[b]Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] First strike on unaware enemy goes unblocked
[*] Smarter group encounters
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Attack one enemy in a group, all others start attacking you
[*] Encounters now spawn as they should, slowdown fix
[*] Blocking behaviour improvements
[*] Music manager messes up less
[*] Player run animations are now consistent
[*] Enemies now get thrown in the garbage when they're useless
[*] Fixed AI EQS looking for garbage, disgusting!
[*] All the IsValid checks, so many IsValid checks.. am I IsValid? We will never know.
[/list]

notes.title: Fixes & Additions 19-08-2022
notes.content:
[b]Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] A loading screen that shows the current control configuration
[*] Roaming AI: not just standing idle anymore but roam a bit
[*] Enemies can run now
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Enemies should see you reliably again
[*] Enemies wont light up behind objects until you've seen them first and spoil the surprise
[*] Combos using the right animations
[*] To and from Combat transition animations are fixed
[*] Skip cutscene button was not working properly due to losing focus
[*] Heavy attack, heavy tweaking
[*] Potential spawn lag fix
[/list]

notes.title: Fixes & Additions 22-07-2022
notes.content:
[h3]Added[/h3]

[list]
[*]Sword clean loop bug
[*]Sword "transition juggling"
[*]Game not pausing on pause menu
[*]Enemies spawning in view of player camera
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*]Sometimes on loading the next wave of enemies, the game takes a little bit to calculate [i]where[/i]..
[/list]
